overview: The default account closed the day at $100,328.32 equity, down $126.13 for the day, holding three open positions: AMD (13 shares, -$390.37 unrealized), GOOGL (31 shares, +$402.17 unrealized), and TSLA (28 shares, -$470.68 unrealized). One order filled today -- a 145-share NFLX sell at $73.32 from the rd_mean_reversion strategy, closing out that position. Two exit signals were generated for NFLX today: the first (14:45) was rejected, the second (16:30) executed successfully -- see Mistakes & Corrected Actions below for why. Against the newly-added S&P 500 benchmark, the default account is running +0.52% ahead of SPY since tracking began on 2026-07-20 (portfolio +0.33% vs SPY -0.19%). The Sneaky Pivot account, tracked separately, opened its benchmark window today at flat/flat with no positions and no trades. Sneaky Pivot's dry-run cycle ran 32 times today (roughly every 15 minutes) and never produced a real signal on any watchlist ticker. The trailing-stop cycle ran 3 times with no stop changes needed. No errors were logged anywhere today.
market_movement: A mixed day across the 16-ticker watchlist. Leaders: NFLX +2.80%, AAL +2.74%, GOOGL +2.53%, MSFT +1.20%, AAPL +0.97%. Laggards: AMD -8.16% (driving today's largest unrealized loss in the open AMD position), INTC -5.92%, NOK -4.09%, SOFI -0.95%. The broad market was roughly flat to slightly down: SPY +0.21%, QQQ -0.88%.

mistakes_and_corrections.summary: A legitimate NFLX exit signal (mean-reversion z-score reverted to 0.27, signaling the position should close) was generated at 14:45 but rejected by the execution loop, which requires a quantity on every signal and this one had none -- a bug in the mean-reversion screener that never set a share quantity on sell/exit signals, only on buy signals.
mistakes_and_corrections.corrected_action: The screener was fixed to look up the real Alpaca-held quantity for exit signals. A second, corrected NFLX exit signal generated at 16:30 carried the right quantity and executed successfully at 17:40, selling all 145 shares at $73.32 and closing the position as originally intended.
